# `catalogue/relabel`

Titles are display, identifiers are not. `relabelled` returns a copy of a pane with new
labels applied by source field, so a host can localise or rename what a catalogue authored without
touching the ids anything else keys on.

## Example

```ts
import { relabelled, type RelabellablePane } from 'lightweight-magic-charts';

declare const pane: RelabellablePane;

export const renamed = relabelled(pane, new Map([['close', 'Fechamento']]), 'Preço', undefined);
```

## Exports

- **`BoundSeries`** · type · `interface BoundSeries { spec: SeriesSpec; source: { readonly field: string; } }`
- **`RelabellablePane`** · type · `interface RelabellablePane { spec: PaneSpec; series: readonly BoundSeries[] }`
- **`relabelled`** · value · `<P extends RelabellablePane>(pane: P, labels: ReadonlyMap<string, string>, title: string | null, guide?: number) => P`
